caption: Margins and gaps come off the screen first; what is left splits three ways. The same rules re-solve on a 320-point phone and give about 90.67 points per button, which is why constraints replace fixed frames.

spec.title: Width of each button in a fillEqually stack
spec.aria: A downward chain from a 360-point screen: subtract 32 points of margins to get 328 points of content, subtract 16 points of gaps to get 312, divide by 3 to get 104 points per button, and the same rules on a 320-point screen give about 90.67 points.
